purpose: Source-based audit rubric for fixed-evidence Jev on/off development replay; no new-web quality claim.

scoring_contract.core_supported_completion: All must_cover items answered materially; source title lists and generic clarification do not count. Core and added unsupported details are scored separately.
scoring_contract.explicit_unknown: Required unknown items must be left unconfirmed in clear wording. Unconfirmed must not become false/nonexistent/prohibited.
scoring_contract.unsupported_assertions: Assess all asserted school facts against this fixed batch, including optional guidance. Generic suggestions are distinct from claimed mandatory procedures.
scoring_contract.wrong_whole_refusal: For full/partial categories, hiding supported core facts because some part is unknown is an erroneous whole-turn refusal.
scoring_contract.source_scope_preserved: Preserve historical scope, audience, exceptions and contradictory source conditions when asserting the corresponding fact.
scoring_contract.status_is_not_quality: success/limited/empty/needs_clarification are metadata, not automatic quality labels.
scoring_contract.none_category: No core positive fact is required; clear uncertainty is useful success. An unrelated activation tutorial or source-only fallback does not answer the asked unknown.
scoring_contract.semantic_judgment: Use semantic equivalence, not literal keyword matching. Record omitted core facts separately from hallucinated additions.
